Professionals Templates · Presentation

Presentation templates

16 layouts 1920 × 1080, export at 2× Measured: every mark ≥ 5.0:1

Sixteen slide layouts that cover a real deck: opening, structure, argument, evidence, proof and close. Built at full export size and shown at half scale, so every value here is the value you set. Rules: Professionals Brand Guidelines.

The four rules these layouts encode
  • Nothing coloured sits behind a word. No marker, no highlight, no tinted box under a line of type. Colour is the field the type sits on, or it is a button, and nothing in between.
  • Use only the approved colour fields and accessible text pairings. Charcoal or white text is chosen by contrast. Every mark on every slide must clear the documented accessibility threshold.
  • A photograph may fill the whole slide as long as the type still clears 4.5:1. That is bought with a gradient that runs off the edge of the frame, not with a panel dropped on top of the picture.
  • The Professionals is a shape, never a bullet. Maximum three per slide, rotated no more than 30°, and lists use a rule or a chip instead.

Slides are laid out at 1920 × 1080 and scaled to fit this page, so the pixel values in the markup are production values. Export at 2× for a projector. The Professionals shapes are decoration and never carry meaning: a slide still has to read with all of them removed.
